## What changed

Describe the smallest complete change and the problem it solves.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests, lint, typing, doctor, and build pass.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, customer material, or private holdouts are included.
- [ ] Released datasets, rubrics, plans, schemas, and historical artifacts were not modified in place.
- [ ] New or changed metrics define semantics, parameters, edge cases, and hard/soft-fail behavior.
- [ ] New data and assets include origin, rights, consent where applicable, and redistribution terms.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and compatibility impact are documented.

## Claims and security

State any change to result meaning, comparability, egress, authentication,
parsing, sandboxing, reporting, or official-run gates. Write `None` when absent.
